pro_course_detail.description:
I love British English, and in my last job, we used a teaching method called the Callan Method to help students improve their speaking skills. It's a fast and fun way to learn. With this method, you're speaking all the time and fully engaged. You learn at a natural speed, like native speakers do, which helps you pick up speaking quickly. You don't worry about translating or perfect grammar - it's more about speaking English naturally, like you did as a child learning your first language. We also cover British vocabulary, phrases, and expressions. If you're interested, I have great materials for you.
